MasulloGRH.zetaRegularDomain_open : IsOpen zetaRegularDomain
'MasulloGRH.zetaRegularDomain_open' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.zetaRegularDomain_convex : Convex ℝ zetaRegularDomain
'MasulloGRH.zetaRegularDomain_convex' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.riemannZeta_analytic_regularDomain : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ riemannZeta zetaRegularDomain
'MasulloGRH.riemannZeta_analytic_regularDomain' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.riemannZeta_order_finite {s : ℂ} (hs : s.re < 1) : analyticOrderAt riemannZeta s ≠ ⊤
'MasulloGRH.riemannZeta_order_finite' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.riemannZeta_zero_positive_finite_multiplicity {s : ℂ} (hs : s.re < 1) (hz : riemannZeta s = 0) :
  ∃ n, 0 < n ∧ ∃ g, AnalyticAt ℂ g s ∧ g s ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ᶠ (z : ℂ) in 𝓝 s, riemannZeta z = (z - s) ^ n * g z
'MasulloGRH.riemannZeta_zero_positive_finite_multiplicity' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.zetaDivisor_locally_finite {s : ℂ} (hs : s.re < 1) : ∃ t ∈ 𝓝 s, (t ∩ zetaDivisor.support).Finite
'MasulloGRH.zetaDivisor_locally_finite' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.zetaDivisor_order {s : ℂ} (hs : s.re < 1) : zetaDivisor s = (meromorphicOrderAt riemannZeta s).untop₀
'MasulloGRH.zetaDivisor_order' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.zetaDivisor_nonnegative : 0 ≤ zetaDivisor
'MasulloGRH.zetaDivisor_nonnegative' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'MasulloGRH.riemannZeta_zero_positive_finite_multiplicity' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
MasulloGRH.riemannZeta_zero_positive_finite_multiplicity {s : ℂ} (hs : s.re < 1) (hz : riemannZeta s = 0) :
  ∃ n, 0 < n ∧ ∃ g, AnalyticAt ℂ g s ∧ g s ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ᶠ (z : ℂ) in 𝓝 s, riemannZeta z = (z - s) ^ n * g z
